regime_context: The absolute-trend gate has historically cut drawdown for the TSX; Big Banks lead with high momentum, full breadth, but are crowded. Pipelines and Insurers also crowded. No confirmed handoff; broad eligible rotation (10/16 themes) indicates many themes still active. Macro backdrop dominated by AI/tech and geopolitics headlines, high unscheduled surprise share, adding event risk.
emerging_watch: Utilities & Renewables (eligible, not crowded, durability 0.65, breadth 0.846) — watch for a potential rotation beneficiary if the crowded Bank leadership fades; kill-criterion: if Utilities' durability_bar drops below 0.5 or breadth contracts below 0.7 within 15 trading days, or if Big Banks’ durability strengthens further.

theses.subject: Gold Miners
theses.thesis: The absolute-trend gate, the only validated edge, rejects Gold Miners (eligible=false; durability_bar=0.27, breadth=0.062). This indicates the theme lacks the staying power to avoid significant drawdown, and risk-reward is unfavorable. No crowding signal to contradict. The trend discipline, not momentum rank, drives the lean.
evidence: durability_bar 0.27 — well below typical eligibility thresholds
hurst_tag=trend but not eligible suggests trend is not robust enough to pass filter
theses.dissent: Gold Miners could be a geopolitical hedge; if a macro shock raises gold, the trend gate might be late in re-engaging. Also, low breadth might reverse quickly if a single large stock rallies.

falsifier.text: durability_bar rises above 0.4 and breadth expands above 0.5 within 10 trading days, or the absolute-trend gate flips to eligible for Gold Miners.

macro_narrative.note: market-level macro/policy/geo narrative flow; coincident, not per-theme, never a trigger
